defects.repro: components-inputs--color-picker, look at the 불투명도 range
defects.expected: HJM primary track/thumb like Slider (#075985 light)
defects.actual: Chromium default accent rgb(0,117,255) light, pale blue in dark; .hjm-color-picker CSS sets no accent-color/range styling

defects.regression: pre-existing (same code at 9/29 6c9b155), not caught because 9/29 checked only the motion path in LTR
defects.repro: patterns-optional-motion--playground with globals motion:reduced or direction:rtl
defects.expected: fallback Menu trigger styled like HJM Button, >=44px target
defects.actual: unstyled native <button> (rgb(239,239,239) bg, 2px outset border, 68x26px); menu itself still opens and 저장 selects

observations: Affix story: status span abuts button with no gap (fixture copy, not component)
RTL variants use Korean copy, so neutral punctuation lands at line start (e.g. ColorPicker "#b94627cc :선택한 색상", Watermark ".니다"); expected Unicode bidi, same as 9/29 variants
BottomNavigation 390 fullPage capture shows the fixed bar mid-page: capture artifact of fullPage, not layout
limits: Local headless Chromium only; not Safari/Firefox, screen reader, consumer apps, native, or deployed release. Pointer drag of SortableCollection was not re-run here (keyboard only). Variant matrix is the 9/29 20-input set plus ColorPicker/Watermark/Affix/OptionalMotion/Adapters, not every permutation.
